review.imagery: All fourteen current-page candidate images and both extracted brochure resources were visually inspected. Brand logos and generic lifestyle mood photos were excluded. Nine project-specific entries cover the community, waterfront, mansion exteriors, wellness arrival and interiors. Current website image alt labels that did not describe the visible scene were replaced with direct visual descriptions. The two source-era aerials retain distinct captions.
review.floorPlans: Every original 17-page plan sheet was visually inspected. Fourteen complete drawing sheets are selectable. Physical pages 7, 12 and 17 retain their summary tables in the original PDF. The detailed 3 BR total and mansion level totals were read visually. Existing source conflicts remain explicit. Original source notices and Ritz-Carlton licensing footer remain intact.
review.location: Complete original brochure page 10 visually checked for five destinations and times. Brochure sanctuary and community scope remain explicit. Wider Creek portfolio map coordinates are not asserted as a residential entrance.
review.provenance: Both whole branded PDFs and own current-page media were downloaded through ordinary public GET on 7 November with URL, byte length and SHA receipts. New Developments remains identified as the PDF host. Existing protected text and ownership preserved.

unavailable: Original Sky mansion drawings, verified penthouse layouts beyond the retrieved pack, a resolved mansion revision and individual residence entrance coordinates remain unavailable. Detailed and summary area conflicts require confirmation.
